# Part A: Basic Operations

#A1

```{r A1}
v <- seq(5, 50, by = 5)
print(length(v))
print(sum(v))
print(mean(v))
```

#A2

```{r A2}
w <- rep(c(1, 2, 3), times = 4)
z <- rep(c(1, 2, 3), each = 4)
print(w)
print(z)
```

#A3

```{r A3}
print(17 %% 5)
print(17 %/% 5)
print(2^10)
print(sqrt(144))
print(round(pi, 3))
```

#A4

```{r A4}
a <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)
b <- c(1, 3, 5, 7)
print(a + b)
print(a * b)
print(a > b)
print(sum(a * b))
```

#A5

```{r A5}
print(paste("Student", 1:3, sep = "-"))

print(class(42))                # numeric
print(class(42L))               # integer
print(class("42"))              # character
print(class(41i))               # complex
print(class(TRUE))              # logical
```

# Part B: Data Frames and Conditional Statements

#B1

```{r B1}
students <- data.frame(
  id         = 1:8,
  name       = c("Alice", "Bruno", "Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace", "Hiro"),
  sex        = c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M"),
  section    = c("A", "B", "A", "C", "B", "C", "A", "B"),
  midterm    = c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59),
  final      = c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
  attendance = c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
print(students)
```

#B2

```{r B2}
str(students)
print(dim(students))
print(colnames(students))
print(summary(students))
```

#B3

```{r B3}
students[["average"]] <- (students[["midterm"]] + students[["final"]]) / 2
print(students)
```

#B4

```{r B4}
students[["passed"]] <- students[["average"]] >= 70 & students[["attendance"]] >= 75
print(students)
```

#B5

```{r B5}
students[["standing"]] <- ifelse(students[["average"]] >= 90, "Honors",
                          ifelse(students[["average"]] >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))
print(students)
```

#B6

```{r B6}
classify <- function(score) {
  if (score >= 85) {
    "Distinction"
  } else if (score >= 70) {
    "Merit"
  } else if (score >= 50) {
    "Pass"
  } else {
    "Fail"
  }
}
print(sapply(c(90, 73, 55, 40), classify))
```

# Part C: rbind() and cbind()

#C1

```{r C1}
new_students <- data.frame(
  id         = c(9, 10),
  name       = c("Ines", "Jamal"),
  sex        = c("F", "M"),
  section    = c("C", "A"),
  midterm    = c(81, 70),
  final      = c(84, 68),
  attendance = c(92, 80),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
new_students[["average"]]  <- (new_students[["midterm"]] + new_students[["final"]]) / 2
new_students[["passed"]]   <- new_students[["average"]] >= 70 & new_students[["attendance"]] >= 75
new_students[["standing"]] <- ifelse(new_students[["average"]] >= 90, "Honors",
                              ifelse(new_students[["average"]] >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

students_all <- rbind(students, new_students)
print(students_all)
```

#C2

```{r C2}
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 6, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)
students_all <- cbind(students_all, quiz = quiz)
print(students_all)
print(class(students_all))
```

#C3

```{r C3}
m <- cbind(midterm = students_all[["midterm"]], final = students_all[["final"]])
m <- rbind(m, mean = colMeans(m, na.rm = TRUE))
print(m)
```

#C4

```{r C4}
# rbind() on data frames requires matching column names. If the names differ,
# it stops with the error "names do not match previous names". tryCatch()
# lets us catch that error, print the message, and continue without crashing.
bad <- students
names(bad) <- "student_name"

tryCatch(rbind(students, bad),
         error = function(e) {
           message("rbind failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
           NULL
         })
```

# Part D: Extracting and Subsetting

#D1

```{r D1}
print(getElement(students_all, "name"))
print(students_all[["name"]])
print(students_all[, "name"])
```

#D2

```{r D2}
print(students_all[2:5, c("name", "midterm", "final")])
```

#D3

```{r D3}
print(students_all[students_all[["attendance"]] > 90, ])
```

#D4

```{r D4}
print(subset(students_all,
             sex == "F" & section %in% c("A", "C") & final >= 75,
             select = c(name, section, final)))
```

#D5

```{r D5}
print(students_all[["name"]][which.max(students_all[["average"]])])
print(students_all[["name"]][which.min(students_all[["average"]])])
```

#D6

```{r D6}
sorted <- students_all[order(students_all[["average"]], decreasing = TRUE), ]
print(head(sorted, 3))
```

# Part E: Basic Factors

#E1

```{r E1}
students_all[["section"]] <- factor(students_all[["section"]])
students_all[["sex"]]     <- factor(students_all[["sex"]])
print(levels(students_all[["section"]]))
print(levels(students_all[["sex"]]))
```

#E2

```{r E2}
print(table(students_all[["sex"]]))
print(table(students_all[["section"]]))
print(table(students_all[["sex"]], students_all[["section"]]))
```

#E3

```{r E3}
print(as.integer(students_all[["sex"]]))
# The integers are the internal codes of the factor levels. Levels are sorted
# alphabetically, so F = 1 and M = 2.
```

#E4

```{r E4}
students_all[["sex_label"]] <- factor(students_all[["sex"]],
                                      levels = c("F", "M"),
                                      labels = c("Female", "Male"))
print(levels(students_all[["sex_label"]]))
```

#E5

```{r E5}
print(summary(students_all[["sex_label"]]))

print(mean(students_all[["average"]][students_all[["sex_label"]] == "Female"]))
print(mean(students_all[["average"]][students_all[["sex_label"]] == "Male"]))
```
